run_vis_cam_cli: run the vis_cam CLI tool to visualize class activation maps on an image using a pretrained model
run_gradcam_visualization: run GradCAM visualization on an image with a config file and checkpoint to generate heatmaps
run_vit_cam_visualization: run CAM visualization on ViT-like networks by specifying the --vit-like flag and extra tokens
run_cam_with_target_layers: run CAM visualization targeting specific model layers using the --target-layers argument
run_cam_save_output: run CAM visualization and save the output heatmap image to a specified path with --save-path
